top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a specific, non-obvious prediction (the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) and the 2018 experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states that opened a new regime of quantum matter, reproduced by many groups. A citation limited to the prediction and the observation of the phases does not depend on the unresolved pairing mechanism. The cost is credit: Cao and other experimental groups fall outside three names. P001 is cleaner on credit and maturity and is a close second, but its main payoffs are partly prospective and it extends a recognised line; P003 has the thinnest support and credit gaps (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan); any award is preferred to none.
recusal_note: none apparent for P001, P002 or P003 from profile; my proximity to circuit QED (Chalmers colleagues Delsing and Wilson, WACQT) would have required recusal on a circuit-QED proposal, but none is in the slate
